positions.commentary: Bill Gates would go long on Amazon, viewing it as a strong company with a focused top-down approach compared to Facebook.
Bill Gates views Facebook (Meta) as a company making one big bet on the Meta Wars, and notes Mark Zuckerberg has become a cost-cutting guy.
Bill Gates would definitely go long on Microsoft.
Bill Gates is famously short Tesla because Elon Musk complains about it on Twitter.
